description: The agent must: (1) Read task_requirements/qingshi_draft.txt to understand the document requirements. (2) Locate and study the skill at .trae/skills/official-doc-writer/ — specifically scripts/generate_official_doc.py — to understand the create_official_document() API and content dict schema. (3) Apply the following GB/T 9704-2012 proprietary corrections that are NOT obvious from generic knowledge: (a) Fix 发文字号 brackets from wrong '沈大数经[2026]5号' to correct '沈大数经〔2026〕5号' using 六角括号; (b) Fix date from '2026年8月05日' to '2026年8月5日' (no zero-padding on day); (c) Use the correct 请示 ending phrase '妥否，请批示。' (not generic endings). (4) Construct the full content dict with: issuer, doc_number (corrected), title, recipient, body (with proper structural hierarchy markers 一、/（一）/（二） etc.), signer, date (corrected), signee (王建国), attachment, copy_to. (5) Call create_official_document('请示', content) and save as qingshi_2026.docx anywhere in the workspace. The critical proprietary traps are the 六角括号 vs normal brackets distinction, the no-zero-padding date rule, and the type-specific ending phrase.
